news.headline: VMware patches vCenter zero-day that Chinese-linked hackers exploited since September
news.summary: Broadcom has released security updates for a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass. Chinese-linked hackers have been exploiting the flaw as a zero-day since September 2026. Administrators running vCenter should apply the patches promptly.
news.chaosTwist: Somewhere in the North Pole data center, Santa's elves found an uninvited guest hiding in the vCenter sleigh and have been asked to evict it before the reindeer notice.

sources.title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
